hints.title: Bitmask State Representation
hints.text: Because 2n <= 14, represent the subset of selected elements as a bitmask of length 2n.

hints.title: Derive Operation Round
hints.text: The current operation round number equals (count of set bits in mask) / 2 + 1.

hints.title: Pair Unused Elements
hints.text: Try all pairs of unused indices (i, j); transition to new state with score increment round * gcd(nums[i], nums[j]).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask dynamic programming memoizes 2^14 = 16,384 states, evaluating each in O((2n)^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses bitmask DP with gcd precomputation over 2n elements.
